title: Theory Expander_Graphs_MGG
source_type: Official Isabelle/HOL formalization of an established theorem

verified_definitions.mgg_graph_step: On Z_n x Z_n: (x +/- 2y,y), (x +/- (2y+1),y), (x,y +/- 2x), (x,y +/- (2x+1)); eight labeled arcs, retaining multiplicity.

verified_theorems.mgg_numerical_radius_aux: For every real zero-sum f, abs(sum over labeled arcs f(head)*f(tail)) <= 5*sqrt(2)*sum over vertices f(v)^2.
verified_theorems.mgg_numerical_radius: Normalized nonconstant numerical radius is at most MGG_bound.
